integrity: Exact all-parameter proof with reproducible standalone finite checker; same-model review only; no claim of external mathematical certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only even n>=6; neither exceptional n=4 nor twisted toroidal lattices nor already studied odd-length circulant subfamilies are classified; all-parameter proof uses fiberwise Morse and integral winding, not finite sampling.
title: Two circle-and-sphere wedges for open neighborhoods of even \(C_4\square C_n\) tori
